places-abrigo-de-la-llagosa-cueva-del-ti.story: From Nerpio it runs 245 km to Nerpio; allow about 4 h 13 of riding. On the way it passes Cueva de las Palamas, Cueva del Tio Labrador and back through Cueva de las Palamas. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.
